title: Remove outliers IQR
solution:
def iqr_filter(df):
    q1, q3 = df["value"].quantile([0.25, 0.75])
    iqr = q3 - q1
    return df[(df["value"] >= q1 - 1.5*iqr) & (df["value"] <= q3 + 1.5*iqr)]

title: Filter incremental
solution:
import pandas as pd

def incremental(df, watermark):
    ts = pd.to_datetime(df["updated_at"], utc=True)
    return df[ts > pd.to_datetime(watermark, utc=True)]
